Class XorFilterBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.apache.datasketches.filters.xorfilter.XorFilterBuilder
public final class XorFilterBuilder extends Object
This class accumulates items and builds an immutable XorFilter from them. Because the xor filter construction algorithm needs the full set of items at once, items are added to the builder with the update methods and the filter is produced with a single call to build().

Items are reduced to 64-bit keys as they are added, so the builder retains only one long per item regardless of the item's type or size. Duplicate items are removed automatically when the filter is built.

The underlying algorithm is described in Graf and Lemire, "Xor Filters: Faster and Smaller Than Bloom and Cuckoo Filters," ACM Journal of Experimental Algorithmics, 2020.

    • update

      public XorFilterBuilder update(String item)
      Updates the builder with the provided String. The string is converted to a byte array using UTF8 encoding.

      Note: this will not produce the same output hash values as the update(char[]) method and will generally be a little slower depending on the complexity of the UTF8 encoding.

      Parameters:
      item - an item with which to update the builder
      Returns:
      this builder
